verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֔וא וַיֵּ֥רֶד יְהוּדָ֖ה מֵאֵ֣ת אֶחָ֑יו וַיֵּ֛ט עַד־ אִ֥ישׁ עֲדֻלָּמִ֖י וּשְׁמ֥וֹ חִירָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî bā·‘êṯ ha·hi·w way·yê·reḏ yə·hū·ḏāh mê·’êṯ ’e·ḥāw way·yêṭ ‘aḏ- ’îš ‘ă·ḏul·lā·mî ū·šə·mōw ḥî·rāh
verses.literal: About that time Judah . . . left his brothers and settled near a man named Hirah an Adullamite
verses.literalPt: Nesse tempo, separou-se Judá de seus irmãos e uniu-se a um adulamita que se chamava Hira.

verses.original: וַיַּרְא־ שָׁ֧ם יְהוּדָ֛ה בַּת־ אִ֥ישׁ כְּנַעֲנִ֖י וּשְׁמ֣וֹ שׁ֑וּעַ וַיִּקָּחֶ֖הָ וַיָּבֹ֥א אֵלֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yar- šām yə·hū·ḏāh baṯ- ’îš kə·na·‘ă·nî ū·šə·mōw šū·a‘ way·yiq·qā·ḥe·hā way·yā·ḇō ’ê·le·hā
verses.literal: There Judah saw the daughter of a Canaanite man named Shua and he took her as a wife and slept with her
verses.literalPt: Viu ali a filha dum cananeu, por nome Sua; tomou-a por mulher e a conheceu.

verses.original: וַתַּ֖הַר וַתֵּ֣לֶד בֵּ֑ן וַיִּקְרָ֥א אֶת־ שְׁמ֖וֹ עֵֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wat·ta·har wat·tê·leḏ bên way·yiq·rā ’eṯ- šə·mōw ‘êr
verses.literal: So she conceived and gave birth to a son and Judah named him Er
verses.literalPt: Ela concebeu e deu à luz um filho; e o pai chamou-lhe Er.

verses.original: וַתַּ֥הַר ע֖וֹד וַתֵּ֣לֶד בֵּ֑ן וַתִּקְרָ֥א אֶת־ שְׁמ֖וֹ אוֹנָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wat·ta·har ‘ō·wḏ wat·tê·leḏ bên wat·tiq·rā ’eṯ- šə·mōw ’ō·w·nān
verses.literal: Again she conceived and gave birth to a son and she named him Onan
verses.literalPt: Tornou a conceber e deu à luz um filho, a quem a mãe chamou Onã.

verses.original: וַתֹּ֤סֶף עוֹד֙ וַתֵּ֣לֶד בֵּ֔ן וַתִּקְרָ֥א אֶת־ שְׁמ֖וֹ שֵׁלָ֑ה וְהָיָ֥ה בִכְזִ֖יב בְּלִדְתָּ֥הּ אֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·sep̄ ‘ō·wḏ wat·tê·leḏ bên wat·tiq·rā ’eṯ- šə·mōw šê·lāh wə·hā·yāh ḇiḵ·zîḇ bə·liḏ·tāh ’ō·ṯōw
verses.literal: Then she gave birth to another . . . son and named him Shelah it was at Chezib that she gave birth to him
verses.literalPt: Deu à luz mais um filho e chamou-lhe Selá. Judá estava em Quezibe, quando ela deu à luz.

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֧ח יְהוּדָ֛ה אִשָּׁ֖ה לְעֵ֣ר בְּכוֹר֑וֹ וּשְׁמָ֖הּ תָּמָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ yə·hū·ḏāh ’iš·šāh lə·‘êr bə·ḵō·w·rōw ū·šə·māh tā·mār
verses.literal: Now Judah acquired a wife for Er his firstborn and her name was Tamar
verses.literalPt: Judá tomou para o seu primogênito Er uma mulher, a qual se chamava Tamar.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י עֵ֚ר בְּכ֣וֹר יְהוּדָ֔ה רַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַיְמִתֵ֖הוּ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ‘êr bə·ḵō·wr yə·hū·ḏāh ra‘ bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh way·mi·ṯê·hū Yah·weh
verses.literal: But Er Judah’s firstborn was wicked in the sight of the LORD so the LORD put him to death
verses.literalPt: Ora, Er, o primogênito de Judá, era um homem mau aos olhos de Jeová; assim, Jeová o matou.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוּדָה֙ לְאוֹנָ֔ן בֹּ֛א אֶל־ אֵ֥שֶׁת אָחִ֖יךָ וְיַבֵּ֣ם אֹתָ֑הּ וְהָקֵ֥ם זֶ֖רַע לְאָחִֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer yə·hū·ḏāh lə·’ō·w·nān bō ’el- ’ê·šeṯ ’ā·ḥî·ḵā wə·yab·bêm ’ō·ṯāh wə·hā·qêm ze·ra‘ lə·’ā·ḥî·ḵā
verses.literal: Then Judah said to Onan Sleep with . . . your brother’s wife Perform your duty as her brother-in-law and raise up offspring for your brother
verses.literalPt: Disse Judá a Onã: Toma a mulher de teu irmão, cumpre para com ela o dever dum irmão de seu marido e dá sucessão a teu irmão.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֣דַע אוֹנָ֔ן כִּ֛י לֹּ֥א ל֖וֹ יִהְיֶ֣ה הַזָּ֑רַע וְהָיָ֞ה אִם־ בָּ֨א אֶל־ אֵ֤שֶׁת אָחִיו֙ וְשִׁחֵ֣ת אַ֔רְצָה לְבִלְתִּ֥י נְתָן־ זֶ֖רַע לְאָחִֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ḏa‘ ’ō·w·nān kî lō lōw yih·yeh haz·zā·ra‘ wə·hā·yāh ’im- bā ’el- ’ê·šeṯ ’ā·ḥîw wə·ši·ḥêṯ ’ar·ṣāh lə·ḇil·tî nə·ṯān- ze·ra‘ lə·’ā·ḥîw
verses.literal: But Onan knew that the offspring . . . would not belong to him so whenever he would sleep with . . . his brother’s wife he would spill his seed on the ground so that he would not produce offspring for his brother
verses.literalPt: Mas Onã sabia que os filhos não haviam de ser tidos por seus; assim, todas as vezes que ele se unia à mulher de seu irmão, deixava cair o sêmen no chão, para que não desse sucessão a seu irmão.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֛רַע בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה וַיָּ֖מֶת גַּם־ אֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ra‘ bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh way·yā·meṯ gam- ’ō·ṯōw
verses.literal: What he did was wicked in the sight of the LORD so He put Onan to death as well
verses.literalPt: O que ele fazia era mau aos olhos de Jeová, que o matou também a ele.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוּדָה֩ לְתָמָ֨ר כַּלָּת֜וֹ שְׁבִ֧י אַלְמָנָ֣ה בֵית־ אָבִ֗יךְ עַד־ יִגְדַּל֙ שֵׁלָ֣ה בְנִ֔י כִּ֣י אָמַ֔ר פֶּן־ יָמ֥וּת גַּם־ ה֖וּא כְּאֶחָ֑יו וַתֵּ֣לֶךְ תָּמָ֔ר וַתֵּ֖שֶׁב בֵּ֥ית אָבִֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer yə·hū·ḏāh lə·ṯā·mār kal·lā·ṯōw šə·ḇî ’al·mā·nāh ḇêṯ- ’ā·ḇîḵ ‘aḏ- yiḡ·dal šê·lāh ḇə·nî kî ’ā·mar pen- yā·mūṯ gam- hū kə·’e·ḥāw wat·tê·leḵ tā·mār wat·tê·šeḇ bêṯ ’ā·ḇî·hā
verses.literal: Then Judah said to his daughter-in-law Tamar Live as a widow in your father’s house until my son Shelah grows up For he thought He may die too like his brothers So Tamar went to live in her father’s house
verses.literalPt: Disse Judá a Tamar, sua nora: Fica-te viúva em casa de teu pai, até que meu filho Selá venha a ser homem; porquanto disse: Para que não morra este, como seus irmãos. Assim, se foi Tamar e morou em casa de seu pai.

verses.original: וַיִּרְבּוּ֙ הַיָּמִ֔ים וַתָּ֖מָת בַּת־ שׁ֣וּעַ אֵֽשֶׁת־ יְהוּדָ֑ה וַיִּנָּ֣חֶם יְהוּדָ֗ה וַיַּ֜עַל עַל־ גֹּֽזֲזֵ֤י צֹאנוֹ֙ ה֗וּא וְחִירָ֛ה רֵעֵ֥הוּ הָעֲדֻלָּמִ֖י תִּמְנָֽתָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yir·bū hay·yā·mîm wat·tā·māṯ baṯ- šū·a‘ ’ê·šeṯ- yə·hū·ḏāh way·yin·nā·ḥem yə·hū·ḏāh way·ya·‘al ‘al- gō·ză·zê ṣō·nōw hū wə·ḥî·rāh rê·‘ê·hū hā·‘ă·ḏul·lā·mî tim·nā·ṯāh
verses.literal: After a long time Judah’s wife the daughter of Shua died When Judah had finished mourning he and his friend Hirah the Adullamite went up to his sheepshearers . . . at Timnah
verses.literalPt: No correr do tempo, morreu a filha de Sua, mulher de Judá; e, consolado Judá, subiu a Timna para ir ter com os tosquiadores das suas ovelhas, ele e seu amigo Hira, o adulamita.

verses.original: וַיֻּגַּ֥ד לְתָמָ֖ר לֵאמֹ֑ר הִנֵּ֥ה חָמִ֛יךְ עֹלֶ֥ה תִמְנָ֖תָה לָגֹ֥ז צֹאנֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yug·gaḏ lə·ṯā·mār lê·mōr hin·nêh ḥā·mîḵ ‘ō·leh ṯim·nā·ṯāh lā·ḡōz ṣō·nōw
verses.literal: When Tamar . . . . . . was told Your father-in-law is going up to Timnah to shear his sheep
verses.literalPt: Foi dito a Tamar: Eis que teu sogro sobe a Timna para tosquiar as suas ovelhas.

verses.original: וַתָּסַר֩ בִּגְדֵ֨י אַלְמְנוּתָ֜הּ מֵֽעָלֶ֗יהָ וַתְּכַ֤ס בַּצָּעִיף֙ וַתִּתְעַלָּ֔ף וַתֵּ֙שֶׁב֙ בְּפֶ֣תַח עֵינַ֔יִם אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ דֶּ֣רֶךְ תִּמְנָ֑תָה כִּ֤י רָאֲתָה֙ כִּֽי־ גָדַ֣ל שֵׁלָ֔ה וְהִ֕וא לֹֽא־ נִתְּנָ֥ה ל֖וֹ לְאִשָּֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tā·sar biḡ·ḏê ’al·mə·nū·ṯāh mê·‘ā·le·hā wat·tə·ḵas baṣ·ṣā·‘îp̄ wat·tiṯ·‘al·lāp̄ wat·tê·šeḇ bə·p̄e·ṯaḥ ‘ê·na·yim ’ă·šer ‘al- de·reḵ tim·nā·ṯāh kî rā·’ă·ṯāh kî- ḡā·ḏal šê·lāh wə·hi·w lō- nit·tə·nāh lōw lə·’iš·šāh
verses.literal: she removed her widow’s garments covered her face with a veil to disguise herself and sat at the entrance to Enaim which is on the way to Timnah For she saw that although Shelah had grown up she had not been given to him as a wife
verses.literalPt: Ela se despiu dos vestidos de sua viuvez, se cobriu com um véu, envolveu-se e se assentou à entrada de Enaim, que está no caminho que vai dar a Timna; pois viu que Selá era já homem feito, e ela não lhe fora dada por mulher.

verses.original: וַיִּרְאֶ֣הָ יְהוּדָ֔ה וַֽיַּחְשְׁבֶ֖הָ לְזוֹנָ֑ה כִּ֥י כִסְּתָ֖ה פָּנֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yir·’e·hā yə·hū·ḏāh way·yaḥ·šə·ḇe·hā lə·zō·w·nāh kî ḵis·sə·ṯāh pā·ne·hā
verses.literal: When Judah saw her he thought she was a prostitute because she had covered her face
verses.literalPt: Vendo-a Judá, teve-a por uma prostituta; pois ela tinha coberto o rosto.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֨ט אֵלֶ֜יהָ אֶל־ הַדֶּ֗רֶךְ וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ הָֽבָה־ נָּא֙ אָב֣וֹא אֵלַ֔יִךְ כִּ֚י לֹ֣א יָדַ֔ע כִּ֥י כַלָּת֖וֹ הִ֑וא וַתֹּ֙אמֶר֙ מַה־ תִּתֶּן־ לִּ֔י כִּ֥י תָב֖וֹא אֵלָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yêṭ ’ê·le·hā ’el- had·de·reḵ way·yō·mer hā·ḇāh- nā ’ā·ḇō·w ’ê·la·yiḵ kî lō yā·ḏa‘ kî ḵal·lā·ṯōw hî wat·tō·mer mah- tit·ten- lī kî ṯā·ḇō·w ’ê·lāy
verses.literal: Not realizing that she was his daughter-in-law he went over to her and said Come now let me sleep with you What will you give me for sleeping with . . . you she inquired
verses.literalPt: Então, se chegou a ela no caminho e disse: Vem, deixa-me estar contigo; pois não sabia que ela era sua nora. Perguntou-lhe ela: Que me darás, para estares comigo?

verses.original: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר אָנֹכִ֛י אֲשַׁלַּ֥ח גְּדִֽי־ עִזִּ֖ים מִן־ הַצֹּ֑אן וַתֹּ֕אמֶר אִם־ תִּתֵּ֥ן עֵרָב֖וֹן עַ֥ד שָׁלְחֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ā·nō·ḵî ’ă·šal·laḥ gə·ḏî- ‘iz·zîm min- haṣ·ṣōn wat·tō·mer ’im- tit·tên ‘ê·rā·ḇō·wn ‘aḏ šā·lə·ḥe·ḵā
verses.literal: I will send you a young goat . . . from my flock Judah answered But she replied Only if you leave me something as a pledge until you send it
verses.literalPt: Respondeu ele: Eu te enviarei um cabrito do rebanho. Perguntou ela: Dar-me-ás um penhor, até que o envies?

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר מָ֣ה הָֽעֵרָבוֹן֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֶתֶּן־ לָּךְ֒ וַתֹּ֗אמֶר חֹתָֽמְךָ֙ וּפְתִילֶ֔ךָ וּמַטְּךָ֖ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּיָדֶ֑ךָ וַיִּתֶּן־ לָּ֛הּ וַיָּבֹ֥א אֵלֶ֖יהָ וַתַּ֥הַר לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer māh hā·‘ê·rā·ḇō·wn ’ă·šer ’et·ten- lāḵ wat·tō·mer ḥō·ṯā·mə·ḵā ū·p̄ə·ṯî·le·ḵā ū·maṭ·ṭə·ḵā ’ă·šer bə·yā·ḏe·ḵā way·yit·ten- lāh way·yā·ḇō ’ê·le·hā wat·ta·har lōw
verses.literal: What pledge should I give you he asked She answered Your seal and your cord and the staff in your hand So he gave them to her and slept with her and she became pregnant by him
verses.literalPt: Respondeu ele: Que penhor é o que te darei? Disse ela: Teu selo com a corda e o báculo que tens na mão. Ele, pois, lhos deu e a conheceu, e ela concebeu.

verses.original: וַתָּ֣קָם וַתֵּ֔לֶךְ וַתָּ֥סַר צְעִיפָ֖הּ מֵעָלֶ֑יהָ וַתִּלְבַּ֖שׁ בִּגְדֵ֥י אַלְמְנוּתָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tā·qām wat·tê·leḵ wat·tā·sar ṣə·‘î·p̄āh mê·‘ā·le·hā wat·til·baš biḡ·ḏê ’al·mə·nū·ṯāh
verses.literal: Then Tamar got up and departed And she removed her veil . . . and put on her widow’s garments again
verses.literalPt: Ela, levantando-se, se foi, tirou de si o véu e se vestiu com os vestidos de sua viuvez.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֨ח יְהוּדָ֜ה אֶת־ גְּדִ֣י הָֽעִזִּ֗ים בְּיַד֙ רֵעֵ֣הוּ הָֽעֲדֻלָּמִ֔י לָקַ֥חַת הָעֵרָב֖וֹן מִיַּ֣ד הָאִשָּׁ֑ה וְלֹ֖א מְצָאָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ yə·hū·ḏāh ’eṯ- gə·ḏî hā·‘iz·zîm bə·yaḏ rê·‘ê·hū hā·‘ă·ḏul·lā·mî lā·qa·ḥaṯ hā·‘ê·rā·ḇō·wn mî·yaḏ hā·’iš·šāh wə·lō mə·ṣā·’āh
verses.literal: Now when Judah sent his friend Hirah the Adullamite with the young goat . . . to collect the items he had left with . . . the woman he could not find her
verses.literalPt: Enviou Judá o cabrito por intermédio de seu amigo, o adulamita, para receber o penhor da mão da mulher; porém não a encontrou.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁאַ֞ל אֶת־ אַנְשֵׁ֤י מְקֹמָהּ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר אַיֵּ֧ה הַקְּדֵשָׁ֛ה הִ֥וא בָעֵינַ֖יִם עַל־ הַדָּ֑רֶךְ וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ לֹא־ הָיְתָ֥ה בָזֶ֖ה קְדֵשָֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·’al ’eṯ- ’an·šê mə·qō·māh lê·mōr ’ay·yêh haq·qə·ḏê·šāh hî ḇā·‘ê·na·yim ‘al- had·dā·reḵ way·yō·mə·rū lō- hā·yə·ṯāh ḇā·zeh qə·ḏê·šāh
verses.literal: He asked the men of that place Where is the shrine prostitute who was beside the road at Enaim No shrine prostitute has been here they answered
verses.literalPt: Então, perguntou aos homens daquele lugar: Onde está a prostituta que estava em Enaim, junto ao caminho? Responderam eles: Aqui não tem estado prostituta alguma.

verses.original: וַיָּ֙שָׁב֙ אֶל־ יְהוּדָ֔ה וַיֹּ֖אמֶר לֹ֣א מְצָאתִ֑יהָ וְגַ֨ם אַנְשֵׁ֤י הַמָּקוֹם֙ אָֽמְר֔וּ לֹא־ הָיְתָ֥ה בָזֶ֖ה קְדֵשָֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·šāḇ ’el- yə·hū·ḏāh way·yō·mer lō mə·ṣā·ṯî·hā wə·ḡam ’an·šê ham·mā·qō·wm ’ā·mə·rū lō- hā·yə·ṯāh ḇā·zeh qə·ḏê·šāh
verses.literal: So Hirah returned to Judah and said I could not find her and furthermore the men of that place said No shrine prostitute has been here
verses.literalPt: Tendo voltado a Judá, disse: Não a encontrei; e também os homens do lugar disseram: Aqui não tem estado prostituta alguma.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוּדָה֙ תִּֽקַּֽח־ לָ֔הּ פֶּ֖ן נִהְיֶ֣ה לָב֑וּז הִנֵּ֤ה שָׁלַ֙חְתִּי֙ הַגְּדִ֣י הַזֶּ֔ה וְאַתָּ֖ה לֹ֥א מְצָאתָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer yə·hū·ḏāh tiq·qaḥ- lāh pen nih·yeh lā·ḇūz hin·nêh šā·laḥ·tî hag·gə·ḏî haz·zeh wə·’at·tāh lō mə·ṣā·ṯāh
verses.literal: Let her keep the items Judah replied Otherwise we will become a laughingstock After all I did send her this young goat but you could not find her
verses.literalPt: Respondeu Judá: Que ela o guarde para si, para que não nos tornemos em opróbrio; eis que enviei este cabrito, mais tu não a encontraste.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י׀ כְּמִשְׁלֹ֣שׁ חֳדָשִׁ֗ים וַיֻּגַּ֨ד לִֽיהוּדָ֤ה לֵֽאמֹר֙ זָֽנְתָה֙ תָּמָ֣ר כַּלָּתֶ֔ךָ וְגַ֛ם הִנֵּ֥ה הָרָ֖ה לִזְנוּנִ֑ים וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוּדָ֔ה הוֹצִיא֖וּהָ וְתִשָּׂרֵֽף׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî kə·miš·lōš ḥo·ḏā·šîm way·yug·gaḏ lî·hū·ḏāh lê·mōr zā·nə·ṯāh tā·mār kal·lā·ṯe·ḵā wə·ḡam hin·nêh hā·rāh liz·nū·nîm way·yō·mer yə·hū·ḏāh hō·w·ṣî·’ū·hā wə·ṯiś·śā·rêp̄
verses.literal: About three months later Judah was told Your daughter-in-law Tamar has prostituted herself and now she is pregnant . . . Bring her out Judah replied Let her be burned to death
verses.literalPt: Passados quase três meses, foi dito a Judá: Tamar, tua nora, fornicou; e eis que está pejada da fornicação. Então, disse Judá: Tirai-a para fora, e seja ela queimada.

verses.original: הִ֣וא מוּצֵ֗את וְהִ֨יא שָׁלְחָ֤ה אֶל־ חָמִ֙יהָ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר לְאִישׁ֙ אֲשֶׁר־ אֵ֣לֶּה לּ֔וֹ אָנֹכִ֖י הָרָ֑ה וַתֹּ֙אמֶר֙ הַכֶּר־ נָ֔א לְמִ֞י הַחֹתֶ֧מֶת וְהַפְּתִילִ֛ים וְהַמַּטֶּ֖ה הָאֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.transliteration: hî mū·ṣêṯ wə·hî šā·lə·ḥāh ’el- ḥā·mî·hā lê·mōr lə·’îš ’ă·šer- ’êl·leh lōw ’ā·nō·ḵî hā·rāh wat·tō·mer hak·ker- nā lə·mî ha·ḥō·ṯe·meṯ wə·hap·pə·ṯî·lîm wə·ham·maṭ·ṭeh hā·’êl·leh
verses.literal: As she was being brought out Tamar sent a message to her father-in-law I am pregnant by the man to whom these items belong And she added Please examine them Whose seal and cord and staff are these
verses.literalPt: Havendo sido tirada para fora, mandou ela dizer a seu sogro: Eu concebi do homem de quem são estas coisas; e disse mais: Reconhece de quem são estes, o selo com o cordão e o báculo.

verses.original: וַיַּכֵּ֣ר יְהוּדָ֗ה וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ צָֽדְקָ֣ה מִמֶּ֔נִּי כִּֽי־ עַל־ כֵּ֥ן לֹא־ נְתַתִּ֖יהָ לְשֵׁלָ֣ה בְנִ֑י וְלֹֽא־ יָסַ֥ף ע֖וֹד לְדַעְתָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yak·kêr yə·hū·ḏāh way·yō·mer ṣā·ḏə·qāh mim·men·nî kî- ‘al- kên lō- nə·ṯat·tî·hā lə·šê·lāh ḇə·nî wə·lō- yā·sap̄ ‘ō·wḏ lə·ḏaʿ·tå̄h
verses.literal: Judah recognized the items and said She is more righteous than I since . . . . . . I did not give her to my son Shelah And he did not have relations with her again . . .
verses.literalPt: Reconheceu-os Judá e disse: Ela é mais justa do que eu, porquanto não a entreguei a meu filho Selá. Ele, pois, nunca mais a conheceu.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֖י בְּעֵ֣ת לִדְתָּ֑הּ וְהִנֵּ֥ה תְאוֹמִ֖ים בְּבִטְנָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî bə·‘êṯ liḏ·tāh wə·hin·nêh ṯə·’ō·w·mîm bə·ḇiṭ·nāh
verses.literal: When the time came for Tamar to give birth there were twins in her womb
verses.literalPt: Aconteceu que, ao tempo de dar à luz, eis que havia gêmeos no seu ventre.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י בְלִדְתָּ֖הּ וַיִּתֶּן־ יָ֑ד וַתִּקַּ֣ח הַמְיַלֶּ֗דֶת וַתִּקְשֹׁ֨ר עַל־ יָד֤וֹ שָׁנִי֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר זֶ֖ה יָצָ֥א רִאשֹׁנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḇə·liḏ·tāh way·yit·ten- yāḏ wat·tiq·qaḥ ham·yal·le·ḏeṯ wat·tiq·šōr ‘al- yā·ḏōw šā·nî lê·mōr zeh yā·ṣā ri·šō·nāh
verses.literal: And as she was giving birth one of them put out his hand so the midwife took a scarlet thread and tied it around his wrist This one came out first she announced
verses.literalPt: Quando estava com dores de parto, um deitou fora a mão, e a parteira tomou e atou na mão dele uma fita encarnada, dizendo: Este saiu primeiro.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י׀ כְּמֵשִׁ֣יב יָד֗וֹ וְהִנֵּה֙ יָצָ֣א אָחִ֔יו וַתֹּ֕אמֶר מַה־ פָּרַ֖צְתָּ עָלֶ֣יךָ פָּ֑רֶץ וַיִּקְרָ֥א שְׁמ֖וֹ פָּֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî kə·mê·šîḇ yā·ḏōw wə·hin·nêh yā·ṣā ’ā·ḥîw wat·tō·mer mah- pā·raṣ·tā ‘ā·le·ḵā pā·reṣ way·yiq·rā šə·mōw pā·reṣ
verses.literal: But when he pulled his hand . . . back and his brother came out she said . . . You have broken out first . . . . . . So he was named . . . Perez
verses.literalPt: Mas, recolhendo ele a mão, saiu seu irmão; e ela disse: Por que fizeste para ti uma rotura? Portanto, foi chamado Perez.

verses.original: וְאַחַר֙ יָצָ֣א אָחִ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל־ יָד֖וֹ הַשָּׁנִ֑י וַיִּקְרָ֥א שְׁמ֖וֹ זָֽרַח׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’a·ḥar yā·ṣā ’ā·ḥîw ’ă·šer ‘al- yā·ḏōw haš·šā·nî way·yiq·rā šə·mōw zā·raḥ
verses.literal: Then his brother came out with the scarlet thread around his wrist and he was named . . . Zerah
verses.literalPt: Depois, saiu seu irmão, em cuja mão estava a fita encarnada; e foi chamado Zera.
